function stepEnemy(e, dt, ctx) {
  const t = e.tune;
  const player = ctx.player;
  const alive = e.alive;

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- dead ----
  if (!alive) {
    e.deadTime += dt;
    if (!t.flying) e.position.y = damp(e.position.y, e.groundY, 6, dt);
    else e.position.y = damp(e.position.y, e.groundY, 3, dt);
    if (e.deadTime > 1.1 && e.group.visible) {
      e.group.visible = false;
      e.despawned = true;
    }
    return;
  }

  _flat.set(player.position.x - e.position.x, 0, player.position.z - e.position.z);
  const dist = _flat.length();
  const canSee = dist < t.sight;

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- hurt ----
  if (e.state === 'hurt') {
    e.stateTime += dt;
    // Ride out the knockback.
    if (e.knock.lengthSq() > 0.01) {
      const nx = e.position.x + e.knock.x * dt;
      const nz = e.position.z + e.knock.z * dt;
      tryMove(e, nx, nz, ctx);
      e.knock.multiplyScalar(Math.exp(-6 * dt));
    }
    if (e.stateTime > 0.45) setState(e, canSee ? 'chase' : 'patrol');
    return;
  }

  // Facing is shared by every active state.
  const faceTarget = () => {
    const want = Math.atan2(_flat.x, _flat.z);
    e.yaw += angleTo(e.yaw, want) * clamp(t.turn * dt, 0, 1);
  };

  switch (e.state) {
    // ------------------------------------------------------------ patrol ----
    case 'patrol': {
      if (!t.stationary) {
        e.wanderTime -= dt;
        if (e.wanderTime <= 0) {
          e.wanderTime = e.rnd.range(1.6, 4.2);
          const a = e.rnd.range(0, Math.PI * 2);
          const r = e.rnd.range(0.35, 1) * t.patrolRadius;
          e.target.set(e.home.x + Math.cos(a) * r, 0, e.home.z + Math.sin(a) * r);
        }
        _to.set(e.target.x - e.position.x, 0, e.target.z - e.position.z);
        const d = _to.length();
        if (d > 0.6) {
          _to.multiplyScalar(1 / d);
          const want = Math.atan2(_to.x, _to.z);
          e.yaw += angleTo(e.yaw, want) * clamp(t.turn * 0.5 * dt, 0, 1);
          const sp = t.speed * e.rnd_speed;
          if (!tryMove(e, e.position.x + _to.x * sp * dt, e.position.z + _to.z * sp * dt, ctx)) {
            e.wanderTime = 0; // blocked — repick immediately
          }
          e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, sp, 6, dt);
        } else {
          e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 6, dt);
        }
      }
      if (canSee && (!t.flees || dist < t.fleeRange)) setState(e, 'alert');
      break;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- alert ----
    case 'alert': {
      e.stateTime += dt;
      faceTarget();
      e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 8, dt);
      // Post the "!" every frame; EnemyFx keeps no state of its own.
      ctx.enemyFx?.pushMark(
        _to.copy(e.position).setY(e.position.y + e.meta.height * 1.15),
        e.markColor,
        1,
        ctx.engine.camera
      );
      if (e.stateTime > 0.5) setState(e, t.flees ? 'flee' : 'chase');
      break;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------- flee ----
    // The thief. Runs from the player, which is the whole point: it can only be
    // caught with a charge, so it must be genuinely faster than a run.
    case 'flee': {
      const away = _flat.clone().multiplyScalar(-1);
      const d = away.length();
      if (d > 0.001) away.multiplyScalar(1 / d);
      // Curve back toward home so it never runs itself into the void.
      const homePull = _step.set(e.home.x - e.position.x, 0, e.home.z - e.position.z);
      const homeDist = homePull.length();
      if (homeDist > t.patrolRadius * 1.6) {
        homePull.multiplyScalar(1 / Math.max(0.001, homeDist));
        away.lerp(homePull, 0.55).normalize();
      }
      const want = Math.atan2(away.x, away.z);
      e.yaw += angleTo(e.yaw, want) * clamp(t.turn * dt, 0, 1);
      const sp = t.chaseSpeed;
      if (!tryMove(e, e.position.x + away.x * sp * dt, e.position.z + away.z * sp * dt, ctx)) {
        // Cornered: dodge sideways rather than freezing against the rim.
        tryMove(e, e.position.x - away.z * sp * dt, e.position.z + away.x * sp * dt, ctx);
      }
      e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, sp, 8, dt);
      if (dist > t.sight * 1.4) setState(e, 'patrol');
      break;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- chase ----
    case 'chase': {
      faceTarget();
      if (!t.stationary && dist > t.attackRange * 0.85) {
        const dir = _flat.clone().multiplyScalar(1 / Math.max(0.001, dist));
        const sp = t.chaseSpeed;
        if (!tryMove(e, e.position.x + dir.x * sp * dt, e.position.z + dir.z * sp * dt, ctx)) {
          // Can't follow off the island — hold the edge and wait.
          e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 8, dt);
        } else {
          e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, sp, 6, dt);
        }
      } else {
        e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 9, dt);
      }
      if (dist <= t.attackRange && e.cooldown <= 0) setState(e, 'windup');
      else if (dist > t.sight * 1.5) setState(e, 'patrol');
      break;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ windup / strike ----
    case 'windup': {
      e.stateTime += dt;
      faceTarget();
      e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 10, dt);
      if (e.stateTime >= t.windup) setState(e, 'strike');
      break;
    }

    case 'strike': {
      e.stateTime += dt;
      if (!e.struck) {
        e.struck = true;
        if (t.ranged) {
          ctx.projectiles?.fire(e.position, player.position, e.meta, e.markColor);
        } else if (dist <= t.attackRange + 0.7) {
          ctx.controller?.hurt(t.damage, e.position);
        }
        if (t.flying) {
          // Commit the dive: keep the momentum through the strike.
          e.diveTime = 0.45;
        }
      }
      if (e.stateTime >= t.strike) setState(e, 'recover');
      break;
    }

    case 'recover': {
      e.stateTime += dt;
      e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 8, dt);
      if (e.stateTime >= t.recover) {
        e.cooldown = 0.35;
        setState(e, canSee ? 'chase' : 'patrol');
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  e.cooldown = Math.max(0, e.cooldown - dt);

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ altitude ----
  const g = ctx.world.sampleGround(e.position.x, e.position.z);
  if (g) e.groundY = g.y;
  if (t.flying) {
    // Hover, but drop toward the player during a dive.
    let want = e.groundY + t.hoverHeight + Math.sin(ctx.time * 1.7 + e.phase) * 0.5;
    if (e.diveTime > 0) {
      e.diveTime -= dt;
      want = player.position.y + 0.6;
    }
    e.position.y = damp(e.position.y, want, e.diveTime > 0 ? 9 : 2.6, dt);
  } else {
    e.position.y = damp(e.position.y, e.groundY + (e.meta.groundOffset || 0), 12, dt);
  }
}

/**
 * Enemy behaviour.
 *
 * One state machine, parameterised per archetype, driven once per frame by
 * Enemies.update. Kept separate from the rigs so behaviour can be tuned without
 * touching geometry.
 *
 * States: spawn -> patrol -> alert -> chase -> windup -> strike -> recover
 *         (hurt / flee / dead can interrupt from anywhere)
 *
 * Two rules matter more than the rest:
 *  - Enemies never leave their island. Every move is validated against
 *    `world.sampleGround` before it is committed, so nobody walks into the void.
 *  - Every attack has a visible windup. An attack that lands the same frame it
 *    starts is unreadable and feels unfair.
 */
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { clamp, damp } from '../core/Rng.js';

export const TUNING = {
  gnorc: {
    health: 2, speed: 3.1, chaseSpeed: 5.0, sight: 17, attackRange: 2.0,
    windup: 0.42, strike: 0.16, recover: 0.62, damage: 1, turn: 7,
    patrolRadius: 7, immuneToCharge: false, immuneToFlame: false, gems: 3,
  },
  thief: {
    health: 1, speed: 4.2, chaseSpeed: 9.6, sight: 22, attackRange: 0,
    windup: 0, strike: 0, recover: 0, damage: 0, turn: 9,
    patrolRadius: 11, immuneToCharge: false, immuneToFlame: true, gems: 12,
    flees: true, fleeRange: 15,
  },
  brute: {
    health: 3, speed: 2.0, chaseSpeed: 3.4, sight: 15, attackRange: 2.6,
    windup: 0.78, strike: 0.2, recover: 0.95, damage: 2, turn: 3.2,
    patrolRadius: 5, immuneToCharge: true, immuneToFlame: false, gems: 6,
  },
  flyer: {
    health: 1, speed: 3.4, chaseSpeed: 8.5, sight: 24, attackRange: 2.2,
    windup: 0.5, strike: 0.34, recover: 1.1, damage: 1, turn: 5,
    patrolRadius: 9, immuneToCharge: false, immuneToFlame: false, gems: 4,
    flying: true, hoverHeight: 4.4,
  },
  turret: {
    health: 2, speed: 0, chaseSpeed: 0, sight: 26, attackRange: 24,
    windup: 0.85, strike: 0.1, recover: 1.5, damage: 1, turn: 2.6,
    patrolRadius: 0, immuneToCharge: true, immuneToFlame: false, gems: 5,
    stationary: true, ranged: true,
  },
};

const _to = new THREE.Vector3();
const _step = new THREE.Vector3();
const _flat = new THREE.Vector3();

/** Shortest signed angular difference. */
function angleTo(current, target) {
  let d = target - current;
  while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
  while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
  return d;
}

/**
 * Try to move an enemy to (x, z). Refuses if the destination is off the world,
 * off its home island, or too steep — the enemy simply stays put and picks a
 * new wander target next tick.
 */
function tryMove(e, x, z, ctx) {
  const g = ctx.world.sampleGround(x, z);
  if (!g) return false;
  if (g.islandId !== e.homeIsland) return false;
  if (g.u > 0.9) return false;
  if (!e.tune.flying && g.slope > 0.8) return false;
  e.position.x = x;
  e.position.z = z;
  e.groundY = g.y;
  return true;
}

export function stepEnemy(e, dt, ctx) {
  const t = e.tune;
  const player = ctx.player;
  const alive = e.alive;

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- dead ----
  if (!alive) {
    e.deadTime += dt;
    if (!t.flying) e.position.y = damp(e.position.y, e.groundY, 6, dt);
    else e.position.y = damp(e.position.y, e.groundY, 3, dt);
    if (e.deadTime > 1.1 && e.group.visible) {
      e.group.visible = false;
      e.despawned = true;
    }
    return;
  }

  _flat.set(player.position.x - e.position.x, 0, player.position.z - e.position.z);
  const dist = _flat.length();
  const canSee = dist < t.sight;

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- hurt ----
  if (e.state === 'hurt') {
    e.stateTime += dt;
    // Ride out the knockback.
    if (e.knock.lengthSq() > 0.01) {
      const nx = e.position.x + e.knock.x * dt;
      const nz = e.position.z + e.knock.z * dt;
      tryMove(e, nx, nz, ctx);
      e.knock.multiplyScalar(Math.exp(-6 * dt));
    }
    if (e.stateTime > 0.45) setState(e, canSee ? 'chase' : 'patrol');
    return;
  }

  // Facing is shared by every active state.
  const faceTarget = () => {
    const want = Math.atan2(_flat.x, _flat.z);
    e.yaw += angleTo(e.yaw, want) * clamp(t.turn * dt, 0, 1);
  };

  switch (e.state) {
    // ------------------------------------------------------------ patrol ----
    case 'patrol': {
      if (!t.stationary) {
        e.wanderTime -= dt;
        if (e.wanderTime <= 0) {
          e.wanderTime = e.rnd.range(1.6, 4.2);
          const a = e.rnd.range(0, Math.PI * 2);
          const r = e.rnd.range(0.35, 1) * t.patrolRadius;
          e.target.set(e.home.x + Math.cos(a) * r, 0, e.home.z + Math.sin(a) * r);
        }
        _to.set(e.target.x - e.position.x, 0, e.target.z - e.position.z);
        const d = _to.length();
        if (d > 0.6) {
          _to.multiplyScalar(1 / d);
          const want = Math.atan2(_to.x, _to.z);
          e.yaw += angleTo(e.yaw, want) * clamp(t.turn * 0.5 * dt, 0, 1);
          const sp = t.speed * e.rnd_speed;
          if (!tryMove(e, e.position.x + _to.x * sp * dt, e.position.z + _to.z * sp * dt, ctx)) {
            e.wanderTime = 0; // blocked — repick immediately
          }
          e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, sp, 6, dt);
        } else {
          e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 6, dt);
        }
      }
      if (canSee && (!t.flees || dist < t.fleeRange)) setState(e, 'alert');
      break;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- alert ----
    case 'alert': {
      e.stateTime += dt;
      faceTarget();
      e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 8, dt);
      // Post the "!" every frame; EnemyFx keeps no state of its own.
      ctx.enemyFx?.pushMark(
        _to.copy(e.position).setY(e.position.y + e.meta.height * 1.15),
        e.markColor,
        1,
        ctx.engine.camera
      );
      if (e.stateTime > 0.5) setState(e, t.flees ? 'flee' : 'chase');
      break;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------- flee ----
    // The thief. Runs from the player, which is the whole point: it can only be
    // caught with a charge, so it must be genuinely faster than a run.
    case 'flee': {
      const away = _flat.clone().multiplyScalar(-1);
      const d = away.length();
      if (d > 0.001) away.multiplyScalar(1 / d);
      // Curve back toward home so it never runs itself into the void.
      const homePull = _step.set(e.home.x - e.position.x, 0, e.home.z - e.position.z);
      const homeDist = homePull.length();
      if (homeDist > t.patrolRadius * 1.6) {
        homePull.multiplyScalar(1 / Math.max(0.001, homeDist));
        away.lerp(homePull, 0.55).normalize();
      }
      const want = Math.atan2(away.x, away.z);
      e.yaw += angleTo(e.yaw, want) * clamp(t.turn * dt, 0, 1);
      const sp = t.chaseSpeed;
      if (!tryMove(e, e.position.x + away.x * sp * dt, e.position.z + away.z * sp * dt, ctx)) {
        // Cornered: dodge sideways rather than freezing against the rim.
        tryMove(e, e.position.x - away.z * sp * dt, e.position.z + away.x * sp * dt, ctx);
      }
      e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, sp, 8, dt);
      if (dist > t.sight * 1.4) setState(e, 'patrol');
      break;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- chase ----
    case 'chase': {
      faceTarget();
      if (!t.stationary && dist > t.attackRange * 0.85) {
        const dir = _flat.clone().multiplyScalar(1 / Math.max(0.001, dist));
        const sp = t.chaseSpeed;
        if (!tryMove(e, e.position.x + dir.x * sp * dt, e.position.z + dir.z * sp * dt, ctx)) {
          // Can't follow off the island — hold the edge and wait.
          e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 8, dt);
        } else {
          e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, sp, 6, dt);
        }
      } else {
        e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 9, dt);
      }
      if (dist <= t.attackRange && e.cooldown <= 0) setState(e, 'windup');
      else if (dist > t.sight * 1.5) setState(e, 'patrol');
      break;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ windup / strike ----
    case 'windup': {
      e.stateTime += dt;
      faceTarget();
      e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 10, dt);
      if (e.stateTime >= t.windup) setState(e, 'strike');
      break;
    }

    case 'strike': {
      e.stateTime += dt;
      if (!e.struck) {
        e.struck = true;
        if (t.ranged) {
          ctx.projectiles?.fire(e.position, player.position, e.meta, e.markColor);
        } else if (dist <= t.attackRange + 0.7) {
          ctx.controller?.hurt(t.damage, e.position);
        }
        if (t.flying) {
          // Commit the dive: keep the momentum through the strike.
          e.diveTime = 0.45;
        }
      }
      if (e.stateTime >= t.strike) setState(e, 'recover');
      break;
    }

    case 'recover': {
      e.stateTime += dt;
      e.locomotion = damp(e.locomotion, 0, 8, dt);
      if (e.stateTime >= t.recover) {
        e.cooldown = 0.35;
        setState(e, canSee ? 'chase' : 'patrol');
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  e.cooldown = Math.max(0, e.cooldown - dt);

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ altitude ----
  const g = ctx.world.sampleGround(e.position.x, e.position.z);
  if (g) e.groundY = g.y;
  if (t.flying) {
    // Hover, but drop toward the player during a dive.
    let want = e.groundY + t.hoverHeight + Math.sin(ctx.time * 1.7 + e.phase) * 0.5;
    if (e.diveTime > 0) {
      e.diveTime -= dt;
      want = player.position.y + 0.6;
    }
    e.position.y = damp(e.position.y, want, e.diveTime > 0 ? 9 : 2.6, dt);
  } else {
    e.position.y = damp(e.position.y, e.groundY + (e.meta.groundOffset || 0), 12, dt);
  }
}

export function setState(e, next) {
  if (e.state === next) return;
  e.state = next;
  e.stateTime = 0;
  e.struck = false;
  if (e.onState) e.onState(next);
}

/**
 * Deterministic random + noise. Everything procedural in the game must draw from
 * an Rng forked off the run seed so a seed reproduces a run exactly.
 */
import { createNoise2D, createNoise3D } from 'simplex-noise';

export function mulberry32(a) {
  return function () {
    a |= 0;
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

/** FNV-1a — turns a string tag into a 32-bit seed. */
export function hashString(str) {
  let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    h ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
    h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
  }
  return h >>> 0;
}

export class Rng {
  constructor(seed = Date.now()) {
    this.seed = typeof seed === 'string' ? hashString(seed) : seed >>> 0;
    this._next = mulberry32(this.seed);
  }

  next() {
    return this._next();
  }

  /** Uniform in [min, max). */
  range(min, max) {
    return min + this._next() * (max - min);
  }

  /** Integer in [min, max]. */
  int(min, max) {
    return Math.floor(min + this._next() * (max - min + 1));
  }

  bool(p = 0.5) {
    return this._next() < p;
  }

  sign() {
    return this._next() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  }

  pick(arr) {
    return arr[Math.floor(this._next() * arr.length)];
  }

  /** Pick from [{weight, ...}] or from `items` using parallel `weights`. */
  weighted(items, weights) {
    const w = weights || items.map((i) => i.weight ?? 1);
    let total = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < w.length; i++) total += w[i];
    let r = this._next() * total;
    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      r -= w[i];
      if (r <= 0) return items[i];
    }
    return items[items.length - 1];
  }

  /** In-place Fisher-Yates. Returns the same array. */
  shuffle(arr) {
    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(this._next() * (i + 1));
      const t = arr[i];
      arr[i] = arr[j];

**Read this fully before writing code. Do not change any signature in this file.**
If you believe a signature is wrong, implement it as specified anyway and note the

## Ground rules

- Three.js `r180`, ES modules, Vite. `import * as THREE from 'three'`.
- Units: **1 unit = 1 metre. Y is up.** The dragon is ~1.15 m at the shoulder,
  2.2 m nose to tail-tip. Gravity is `-26 m/s²` (game-feel, not physical).
- **Determinism is mandatory.** Never call `Math.random()`. Take an `Rng` and use
  `rng.fork('your-tag')` for each independent stream, so adding a rock does not
  shift enemy placement.
- **Own only your files.** Never edit a file outside your assigned list. If you
  need something from another module, call its contract.
- Everything you add to the scene must set `castShadow` / `receiveShadow`
  deliberately, and must be disposed in your `dispose()`.
- No network requests, no external asset URLs, no CDN. Everything is generated in
  code or bundled. The build must work fully offline.
- Prefer `InstancedMesh` for anything appearing more than ~20 times. Budget:
  the whole scene should stay under ~450 draw calls.

## Core services (already written — consume, don't edit)

/**
 * The enemy cast.
 *
 * Each archetype's rig, geometry and clip set is built exactly once (see
 * enemies/*.js) and then shared: every instance gets its own Skeleton and
 * AnimationMixer but reuses the same BufferGeometry, and every enemy of a given
 * kind in a given biome shares one material. Forty enemies therefore cost forty
 * draw calls and five geometries rather than forty of everything.
 *
 * Behaviour lives in EnemyAI.js. This file owns construction, animation
 * dispatch, damage resolution and the gate/egg-unlock bookkeeping.
 */
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { buildGnorc } from './enemies/Gnorc.js';
import { buildThief } from './enemies/Thief.js';
import { buildBrute } from './enemies/Brute.js';
import { buildFlyer } from './enemies/Flyer.js';
import { buildTurret } from './enemies/Turret.js';
import { enemyPalette } from './enemies/Palette.js';
import { makeEnemyMaterial } from './enemies/Rig.js';
import { EnemyFx, Projectiles } from './enemies/Pop.js';
import { stepEnemy, setState, TUNING } from './EnemyAI.js';
import { getBiome } from '../world/Biomes.js';
import { frame } from '../world/World.js';
import { clamp } from '../core/Rng.js';

const BUILDERS = {
  gnorc: buildGnorc,
  thief: buildThief,
  brute: buildBrute,
  flyer: buildFlyer,
  turret: buildTurret,
};

// Which clip plays in which state. Falls back down the list if a rig is missing
// one, so a partially-authored archetype still animates instead of T-posing.
const STATE_CLIPS = {
  patrol: ['walk', 'idle'],
  idle: ['idle'],
  alert: ['alert', 'idle'],
  chase: ['run', 'walk', 'idle'],
  flee: ['flee', 'run', 'walk', 'idle'],
  windup: ['windup', 'attack', 'alert', 'idle'],
  strike: ['attack', 'idle'],
  recover: ['recover', 'idle'],
  hurt: ['hurt', 'idle'],
  dead: ['die', 'hurt', 'idle'],
};

const _v = new THREE.Vector3();

export class Enemies {
  constructor(ctx) {
    this.ctx = ctx;
    this.group = new THREE.Group();
    this.group.name = 'enemies';
    this.list = [];
    this._archetypes = new Map();
    this._materials = new Map();
    this._gates = new Map();
  }

  async build() {
    const ctx = this.ctx;
    const rng = ctx.rng.fork('enemies');

    this.fx = new EnemyFx(ctx);
    this.fx.build();
    this.group.add(this.fx.group);
    ctx.enemyFx = this.fx;

    try {
      this.projectiles = new Projectiles(ctx);
      this.projectiles.build?.();
      if (this.projectiles.group) this.group.add(this.projectiles.group);
      ctx.projectiles = this.projectiles;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[enemies] projectiles unavailable', err);
      this.projectiles = null;
    }

    // Build every archetype up front — the cost is one-off and it keeps the
    // first encounter from hitching while a rig is generated mid-run.
    for (const kind of Object.keys(BUILDERS)) {
      try {
        this._archetypes.set(kind, BUILDERS[kind]());
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`[enemies] failed to build ${kind}`, err);
      }
      await frame();
    }

    for (const site of ctx.graph.enemySites) {
      const island = ctx.terrain.getIsland(site.island);
      if (!island) continue;
      const biome = island.biome;
      const weights = biome.enemies;
      const srng = rng.fork(`site${site.island}_${site.pos.x.toFixed(1)}_${site.pos.z.toFixed(1)}`);

      // Gates guard an egg and must be beatable head-on, so no thieves there.
      const kinds = Object.keys(weights).filter(
        (k) => this._archetypes.has(k) && weights[k] > 0 && !(site.kind === 'gate' && k === 'thief')

      if (!kinds.length) continue;

      const made = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < site.count; i++) {
        const kind = srng.weighted(kinds.map((k) => ({ k })), kinds.map((k) => weights[k])).k;
        const e = this._spawn(kind, site, island, biome, srng);
        if (e) made.push(e);
      }

      if (site.kind === 'gate' && site.guardsEgg != null && made.length) {
        this._gates.set(site, { remaining: made.length, egg: site.guardsEgg });
        for (const e of made) e.gateSite = site;
      }
      await frame();
    }

    let action = null;
    let chosen = null;
    for (const n of names) {
      if (e.actions[n]) {
        action = e.actions[n];
        chosen = n;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!action || action === e.current) return;
    action.reset();
    action.enabled = true;
    action.setEffectiveWeight(1);
    if (e.current) e.current.crossFadeTo(action, 0.18, false);
    action.play();
    e.current = action;
    e.currentName = chosen;
  }

  /**
   * Apply a hit. Returns true if it connected — the caller uses that to decide
   * whether to spawn feedback, so an immune enemy must report false.
   */
  _hit(e, dmgKind) {
    if (!e.alive || e.iframes > 0) return false;
    const t = e.tune;
    if (dmgKind === 'charge' && t.immuneToCharge) {
      // Bounces off. Still worth feedback so the player learns the rule.
      this.fx?.ring(e.position, e.markColor, 1.6, 0.3);
      this.ctx.events.emit('enemy:deflect', { enemy: e, kind: e.kind, position: e.position.clone() });
      return false;
    }
    if (dmgKind === 'flame' && t.immuneToFlame) return false;

    e.health -= dmgKind === 'flame' ? 2 : 1;
    e.iframes = 0.25;
    this.ctx.events.emit('enemy:hit', { enemy: e, kind: e.kind, position: e.position.clone() });

    if (e.health <= 0) {
      this._kill(e, dmgKind);
    } else {
      _v.subVectors(e.position, this.ctx.player.position).setY(0).normalize();
      e.knock.copy(_v).multiplyScalar(7);
      setState(e, 'hurt');
    }
    return true;
  }

    e.alive = false;
    e.deadTime = 0;
    setState(e, 'dead');
    this.fx?.burst(e.position, e.markColor, new THREE.Color(0xffffff), 18, 1, e.rnd);
    this.fx?.ring(e.position, e.markColor, 2.6, 0.4);
    this.fx?.shake(0.18);

    // Gate bookkeeping: the last guard falling unlocks the egg it was guarding.
    if (e.gateSite) {
      const gate = this._gates.get(e.gateSite);
      if (gate) {
        gate.remaining--;

          this.ctx.events.emit('egg:unlock', { index: gate.egg });

function buildBrute() {
  const rig = new Rig(SPEC);
  const B = new SkinBuilder();

  const wTorso = rig.grouped(['hips', 'spine', 'chest', 'neck'], 2.4, 2);
  const wChest = rig.fixed('chest');
  const wHips = rig.fixed('hips');
  const wHead = rig.fixed('head');

  // -------------------------------------------------------------- torso ----
  // Under-body: dark hide, mostly hidden. It only shows in the plate gaps.
  loftY(
    B,
    [
      { y: 0.86, rx: 0.28, rz: 0.24, exp: 0.6 },
      { y: 1.0, rx: 0.33, rz: 0.27 },
      { y: 1.18, rx: 0.34, rz: 0.28 },
      { y: 1.36, rx: 0.4, rz: 0.3 },
      { y: 1.5, rx: 0.42, rz: 0.3 },
      { y: 1.6, rx: 0.34, rz: 0.26 },
      { y: 1.68, rx: 0.19, rz: 0.18 },
    ],
    {
      sides: 12,
      exp: 0.6,
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wTorso,
      color: (t, c, p) => V(0.6 + t * 0.3),
    }
  );

  // Forge glow bleeding through the seam between the ribs.
  loftY(
    B,
    [
      { y: 1.2, rx: 0.3, rz: 0.05, cz: 0.26 },
      { y: 1.28, rx: 0.32, rz: 0.05, cz: 0.27 },
      { y: 1.35, rx: 0.3, rz: 0.05, cz: 0.26 },
    ],
    { sides: 8, exp: 0.9, slot: SLOT.glowB, weights: wTorso, color: () => V(1.0), capStart: false, capEnd: false }
  );

  // --------------------------------------------------------- chest plate ----
  // Three stacked facets so the light breaks across the front.
  const chestFacets = [
    { c: P(0, 1.55, 0.2), s: [0.66, 0.2, 0.3], rx: 0.34, v: 1.24 },
    { c: P(0, 1.38, 0.28), s: [0.72, 0.24, 0.28], rx: 0.1, v: 1.1 },
    { c: P(0, 1.17, 0.26), s: [0.66, 0.24, 0.26], rx: -0.16, v: 0.96 },
  ];
  for (const f of chestFacets) {
    boxFlat(B, {
      center: f.c,
      size: f.s,
      rot: new THREE.Euler(f.rx, 0, 0),
      taper: 0.94,
      slot: SLOT.metal,
      weights: wChest,
      color: V(f.v),
    });
  }
  // Back plate + two exhaust stacks.
  boxFlat(B, {
    center: P(0, 1.36, -0.26),
    size: [0.6, 0.5, 0.2],
    rot: new THREE.Euler(-0.08, 0, 0),
    taper: 1.06,
    slot: SLOT.metal,
    weights: wChest,
    color: V(0.86),
  });
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    const st = rig.p(s > 0 ? 'stackL' : 'stackR');
    tube(B, {
      path: [st.clone().add(P(0, -0.06, 0)), st.clone().add(P(0.02 * s, 0.22, -0.05)), st.clone().add(P(0.03 * s, 0.34, -0.08))],
      rings: 5,
      sides: 6,
      profile: (t) => 0.062 - t * 0.014,
      slot: SLOT.metal,
      weights: rig.fixed(s > 0 ? 'stackL' : 'stackR'),
      color: (t) => V(0.72 + t * 0.2),
      capStart: true,
      capEnd: false,
    });
    blob(B, {
      center: st.clone().add(P(0.03 * s, 0.35, -0.08)),
      radius: [0.05, 0.02, 0.05],
      segU: 6,
      segV: 3,
      slot: SLOT.glowA,
      weights: rig.fixed(s > 0 ? 'stackL' : 'stackR'),
      color: () => V(1.1),
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------- pauldrons ----
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    const sfx = s > 0 ? 'L' : 'R';
    const wSh = rig.fixed(`shoulder${sfx}`);
    const sp = rig.p(`shoulder${sfx}`);
    // Two overlapping lames plus a spike ridge.
    boxFlat(B, {
      center: sp.clone().add(P(0.02 * s, 0.06, 0)),
      size: [0.44, 0.26, 0.48],
      rot: new THREE.Euler(0, 0, -0.3 * s),
      taper: 0.72,
      slot: SLOT.metal,
      weights: wSh,
      color: V(1.3),
    });
    boxFlat(B, {
      center: sp.clone().add(P(0.06 * s, -0.14, 0)),
      size: [0.4, 0.18, 0.44],
      rot: new THREE.Euler(0, 0, -0.42 * s),
      taper: 0.86,
      slot: SLOT.metal,
      weights: wSh,
      color: V(1.02),
    });
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      spike(B, {
        base: sp.clone().add(P(0.12 * s, 0.14, i * 0.15)),
        tip: sp.clone().add(P(0.34 * s, 0.26, i * 0.17)),
        radius: 0.052,
        sides: 5,
        slot: SLOT.metal,
        weights: wSh,
        color: (t) => V(1.1 + t * 0.5),
      });
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- arms ----
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    const sfx = s > 0 ? 'L' : 'R';
    const wArm = rig.grouped([`arm${sfx}`, `fore${sfx}`, `hand${sfx}`, `shoulder${sfx}`], 2.6, 2);
    tube(B, {
      path: [rig.p(`arm${sfx}`), rig.p(`fore${sfx}`), rig.p(`hand${sfx}`).add(P(0, 0.04, 0))],
      rings: 6,
      sides: 7,
      profile: (t) => 0.135 - t * 0.02,
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wArm,
      color: (t) => V(0.7 + t * 0.12),
      capStart: true,
    });
    // Banded vambrace.
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      const p = rig.p(`fore${sfx}`).lerp(rig.p(`hand${sfx}`), i * 0.5);
      boxFlat(B, {
        center: p.clone().add(P(0, -0.02, 0)),
        size: [0.28, 0.13, 0.28],
        rot: new THREE.Euler(0, 0, -0.1 * s),
        slot: SLOT.metal,
        weights: wArm,
        color: V(0.9 + i * 0.24),
      });
    }
    // Gauntlet fist — deliberately oversized.
    const hp = rig.p(`hand${sfx}`);
    const wHand = rig.fixed(`hand${sfx}`);
    boxFlat(B, {
      center: hp.clone().add(P(0.01 * s, -0.1, 0.02)),
      size: [0.3, 0.29, 0.34],
      rot: new THREE.Euler(0.12, 0, -0.08 * s),
      taper: 1.1,
      slot: SLOT.metal,
      weights: wHand,
      color: V(1.18),
    });
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      spike(B, {
        base: hp.clone().add(P(i * 0.09 * s, -0.06, 0.15)),
        tip: hp.clone().add(P(i * 0.1 * s, -0.02, 0.29)),
        radius: 0.04,
        sides: 5,
        slot: SLOT.metal,
        weights: wHand,
        color: (t) => V(1.2 + t * 0.4),
      });
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- legs ----
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    const sfx = s > 0 ? 'L' : 'R';
    const wLeg = rig.grouped([`thigh${sfx}`, `shin${sfx}`, `foot${sfx}`, 'hips'], 2.8, 2);
    tube(B, {
      path: [rig.p(`thigh${sfx}`).setY(0.94), rig.p(`shin${sfx}`), rig.p(`foot${sfx}`).add(P(0, 0.04, -0.02))],
      rings: 6,
      sides: 8,
      profile: (t) => [0.185 - t * 0.055, 0.175 - t * 0.05],
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wLeg,
      color: (t) => V(0.66 + t * 0.14),
      capStart: true,
      capEnd: false,
    });
    // Thigh cop + greave.
    boxFlat(B, {
      center: rig.p(`thigh${sfx}`).add(P(0.02 * s, -0.14, 0.06)),
      size: [0.36, 0.3, 0.34],
      rot: new THREE.Euler(0.1, 0, -0.06 * s),
      taper: 0.82,
      slot: SLOT.metal,
      weights: rig.fixed(`thigh${sfx}`),
      color: V(0.98),
    });
    boxFlat(B, {
      center: rig.p(`shin${sfx}`).add(P(0, -0.14, 0.05)),
      size: [0.3, 0.3, 0.3],
      rot: new THREE.Euler(-0.06, 0, 0),
      taper: 1.06,
      slot: SLOT.metal,
      weights: rig.fixed(`shin${sfx}`),
      color: V(1.14),
    });
    // Slab foot.
    boxFlat(B, {
      center: P(0.245 * s, 0.075, 0.09),
      size: [0.32, 0.15, 0.46],
      taper: 0.9,
      slot: SLOT.metal,
      weights: rig.fixed(`foot${sfx}`),
      color: V(0.84),
    });
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- head ----
  // Tiny. Almost entirely helmet, one glowing slit, jammed between the pauldrons.
  const hy = 1.72;
  loftZ(
    B,
    [
      { z: -0.12, hw: 0.11, top: 0.1, bot: 0.09, cy: hy },
      { z: -0.03, hw: 0.16, top: 0.14, bot: 0.12, cy: hy },
      { z: 0.07, hw: 0.155, top: 0.13, bot: 0.13, cy: hy - 0.01 },
      { z: 0.16, hw: 0.115, top: 0.08, bot: 0.11, cy: hy - 0.03 },
    ],
    { sides: 10, exp: 0.5, slot: SLOT.metal, weights: wHead, color: (t, c, p) => V(0.9 + (p.y - hy) * 1.1) }
  );
  // Visor slit.
  boxFlat(B, {
    center: P(0, hy + 0.015, 0.15),
    size: [0.26, 0.05, 0.07],
    slot: SLOT.glowA,
    weights: wHead,
    color: V(1.2),
  });
  boxFlat(B, {
    center: P(0, hy - 0.055, 0.145),
    size: [0.24, 0.09, 0.07],
    slot: SLOT.none,
    weights: wHead,
    color: GAP,
  });
  // Crest.
  plate(B, {
    corners: [P(-0.018, hy + 0.13, -0.1), P(0.018, hy + 0.13, -0.1), P(0.018, hy + 0.3, 0.02), P(-0.018, hy + 0.3, 0.02)],
    thickness: 0.05,
    slot: SLOT.metal,
    weights: wHead,
    color: V(1.35),
  });
  // Two horns off the helmet, swept forward — the charge-bounce warning.
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    spike(B, {
      base: P(0.13 * s, hy + 0.06, -0.02),
      tip: P(0.3 * s, hy + 0.12, 0.2),
      radius: 0.05,
      sides: 5,
      bend: P(0, -0.06, 0.04),
      slot: SLOT.metal,
      weights: wHead,
      color: (t) => V(1.05 + t * 0.5),
    });
  }

  // Hip skirt of overlapping tassets, so the legs read as separate from the torso.
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const a = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI / 6;
    boxFlat(B, {
      center: P(Math.sin(a) * 0.3, 0.94, Math.cos(a) * 0.26),
      size: [0.24, 0.3, 0.12],
      rot: new THREE.Euler(0.1, a, 0),
      taper: 1.2,
      slot: SLOT.metal,
      weights: wHips,
      color: V(0.78 + (i % 2) * 0.2),
    });
  }

  return { rig, geometry: B.toGeometry(), clips: clips(rig), meta: META };
}

export function plate(B, opts) {
  const { corners, thickness = 0.012, color, slot = 0, weights, normal = null } = opts;
  const [a, b, c, d] = corners;
  const nrm = normal
    ? normal.clone().normalize()
    : new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(_v0.subVectors(b, a), _v1.subVectors(d, a)).normalize();
  const off = nrm.clone().multiplyScalar(thickness * 0.5);
  const up = [a, b, c, d].map((p) => p.clone().add(off));
  const dn = [a, b, c, d].map((p) => p.clone().sub(off));
  const col = typeof color === 'function' ? color(a) : color;
  const w = (p) => (typeof weights === 'function' ? weights(p) : weights);
  B.quadFlat(up[0], up[1], up[2], up[3], col, w(a), slot);
  B.quadFlat(dn[3], dn[2], dn[1], dn[0], col, w(a), slot);
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const j = (i + 1) % 4;
    B.quadFlat(up[j], up[i], dn[i], dn[j], col, w(up[i]), slot);
  }
}

/** Cone / spike, from base centre to tip. */
export function spike(B, opts) {
  const { base, tip, radius, sides = 6, color, slot = 0, weights, bend = null } = opts;
  const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(tip, base);
  const len = dir.length();
  dir.normalize();
  let side = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(UP, dir);
  if (side.lengthSq() < 1e-6) side.set(1, 0, 0);
  side.normalize();
  const bi = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(dir, side).normalize();

  const RINGS = bend ? 5 : 2;
  const grid = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < RINGS; i++) {
    const t = i / (RINGS - 1);
    const r = radius * (1 - t) * (1 - t * 0.25);
    const centre = base.clone().addScaledVector(dir, len * t);
    if (bend) centre.addScaledVector(bend, t * t);
    const row = [];
    for (let s = 0; s < sides; s++) {
      const a = (s / sides) * Math.PI * 2;
      row.push(centre.clone().addScaledVector(side, Math.cos(a) * r).addScaledVector(bi, Math.sin(a) * r));
    }
    grid.push(row);
  }
  // Pinch the last ring into a point.
  const tipP = grid[RINGS - 1][0].clone();
  for (const p of grid[RINGS - 1]) tipP.copy(p);
  const last = base.clone().addScaledVector(dir, len);
  if (bend) last.add(bend);
  for (const p of grid[RINGS - 1]) p.copy(last);

  return emitGrid(B, grid, { color, slot, weights, wrap: true, capStart: true });
}

const VERT_HEAD = /* glsl */ `
attribute float aSlot;
varying float vSlot;
uniform vec3 uSkin;
uniform vec3 uCloth;
uniform vec3 uMetal;
uniform vec3 uGlowA;
uniform vec3 uGlowB;
`;

const VERT_COLOR = /* glsl */ `
vSlot = aSlot;
vec3 slotCol = vec3(1.0);
if (aSlot > 4.5) slotCol = uGlowB * 2.0;
else if (aSlot > 3.5) slotCol = uGlowA * 2.0;
else if (aSlot > 2.5) slotCol = uMetal * 2.0;
else if (aSlot > 1.5) slotCol = uCloth * 2.0;
else if (aSlot > 0.5) slotCol = uSkin * 2.0;
vColor.xyz *= slotCol;
`;

const FRAG_HEAD = /* glsl */ `
varying float vSlot;
uniform vec4 uHit;
uniform vec3 uGlowA;
uniform vec3 uGlowB;
uniform vec2 uGlowPower;
`;

const FRAG_EMISSIVE = /* glsl */ `
float gA = step(3.5, vSlot) * (1.0 - step(4.5, vSlot));
float gB = step(4.5, vSlot);
totalEmissiveRadiance += uGlowA * gA * uGlowPower.x + uGlowB * gB * uGlowPower.y;
`;

const FRAG_TINT = /* glsl */ `
gl_FragColor.rgb = mix(gl_FragColor.rgb, uHit.rgb, uHit.a);
`;

 * program for the whole cast — the cache key is constant.
 */
export function makeEnemyMaterial(palette, opts = {}) {
  const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    vertexColors: true,
    roughness: opts.roughness ?? 0.72,
    metalness: opts.metalness ?? 0.05,
    emissive: 0xffffff,
    emissiveIntensity: 1,
    dithering: true,
    side: THREE.DoubleSide,
  });
  // Emissive is driven entirely by totalEmissiveRadiance below.
  mat.emissive.setRGB(0, 0, 0);

  const u = {
    uSkin: { value: new THREE.Color(palette.skin) },
    uCloth: { value: new THREE.Color(palette.cloth) },
    uMetal: { value: new THREE.Color(palette.metal) },
    uGlowA: { value: new THREE.Color(palette.glowA) },
    uGlowB: { value: new THREE.Color(palette.glowB) },
    uGlowPower: { value: new THREE.Vector2(palette.glowPowerA ?? 1.1, palette.glowPowerB ?? 1.1) },
    uHit: { value: new THREE.Vector4(1, 1, 1, 0) },
  };
  mat.userData.u = u;

  mat.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
    Object.assign(shader.uniforms, u);
    shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader
      .replace('#include <common>', '#include <common>\n' + VERT_HEAD)
      .replace('#include <color_vertex>', '#include <color_vertex>\n' + VERT_COLOR);
    shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader
      .replace('#include <common>', '#include <common>\n' + FRAG_HEAD)
      .replace('#include <emissivemap_fragment>', '#include <emissivemap_fragment>\n' + FRAG_EMISSIVE)
      .replace('#include <dithering_fragment>', '#include <dithering_fragment>\n' + FRAG_TINT);
  };
  mat.customProgramCacheKey = () => 'enemy-skin-v1';
  return mat;
}

 * Shared skinning toolkit for the enemy cast.
 *
 * Same strategy as the dragon: author a bone tree, read the bind-pose world

 *     The biome tint is then a handful of uniforms, so the same buffer serves a

function forEachVertex(geometry, visit) {
  const pos = attribute(geometry, 'position');
  const count = pos.count;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) visit(i, pos.getX(i), pos.getY(i), pos.getZ(i));

function collectVertices(geometry, predicate) {

}

function trackValues(track) {

function buildFlyer() {
  const rig = new Rig(SPEC);
  const B = new SkinBuilder();

  const wBody = rig.grouped(['root', 'neck', 'abdA'], 2.4, 2);
  const wHead = rig.fixed('head');
  const wJaw = rig.fixed('jaw');
  const wTail = rig.grouped(['abdA', 'abdB', 'sting'], 2.6, 2);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------- thorax ----
  loftZ(
    B,
    [
      { z: -0.24, hw: 0.06, top: 0.05, bot: 0.05 },
      { z: -0.14, hw: 0.13, top: 0.12, bot: 0.11 },
      { z: -0.02, hw: 0.17, top: 0.16, bot: 0.14 },
      { z: 0.1, hw: 0.15, top: 0.14, bot: 0.12 },
      { z: 0.2, hw: 0.1, top: 0.09, bot: 0.08 },
    ],
    { sides: 10, exp: 0.72, slot: SLOT.skin, weights: wBody, color: (t, c, p) => V(0.82 + (p.y + 0.16) * 0.7) }
  );
  // Chest fur ruff — breaks the pod shape and catches the rim light.
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    const a = (i / 7) * Math.PI * 2;
    const r = 0.17;
    spike(B, {
      base: P(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r * 0.9, -0.02),
      tip: P(Math.cos(a) * (r + 0.09), Math.sin(a) * (r + 0.08) * 0.9, -0.12),
      radius: 0.045,
      sides: 4,
      slot: SLOT.cloth,
      weights: wBody,
      color: (t) => V(1.0 + t * 0.35),
    });
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ abdomen ----
  tube(B, {
    path: [P(0, -0.02, -0.16), rig.p('abdA'), rig.p('abdB'), rig.p('sting')],
    rings: 8,
    sides: 8,
    profile: (t) => [0.125 * (1 - t * 0.82), 0.115 * (1 - t * 0.84)],
    slot: SLOT.cloth,
    weights: wTail,
    color: (t) => V(0.8 + (Math.sin(t * 14) > 0 ? 0.42 : 0)),
    capStart: false,
  });
  // Stinger.
  spike(B, {
    base: rig.p('sting').add(P(0, 0, 0.01)),
    tip: rig.p('sting').add(P(0, -0.03, -0.24)),
    radius: 0.038,
    sides: 6,
    slot: SLOT.glowB,
    weights: rig.fixed('sting'),
    color: (t) => V(0.8 + t * 0.9),
  });

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- head ----
  const hz = 0.32;
  loftZ(
    B,
    [
      { z: hz - 0.09, hw: 0.075, top: 0.07, bot: 0.06, cy: 0.05 },
      { z: hz - 0.02, hw: 0.11, top: 0.1, bot: 0.08, cy: 0.05 },
      { z: hz + 0.06, hw: 0.095, top: 0.08, bot: 0.075, cy: 0.045 },
      { z: hz + 0.13, hw: 0.055, top: 0.045, bot: 0.05, cy: 0.035 },
    ],
    { sides: 9, exp: 0.66, slot: SLOT.skin, weights: wHead, color: (t) => V(1.0 + t * 0.2) }
  );
  // Two enormous eyes — the whole face.
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    blob(B, {
      center: P(0.072 * s, 0.075, hz + 0.02),
      radius: [0.062, 0.066, 0.055],
      segU: 8,
      segV: 6,
      slot: SLOT.none,
      weights: wHead,
      color: () => DARKC,
    });
    blob(B, {
      center: P(0.078 * s, 0.078, hz + 0.055),
      radius: [0.042, 0.046, 0.03],
      segU: 7,
      segV: 5,
      slot: SLOT.glowA,
      weights: wHead,
      color: (u, v) => V(1.0 + (1 - v) * 0.55),
    });
    // Swept-back ear cone.
    spike(B, {
      base: P(0.07 * s, 0.11, hz - 0.05),
      tip: P(0.19 * s, 0.3, hz - 0.2),
      radius: 0.05,
      sides: 5,
      bend: P(0.02 * s, -0.04, 0),
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wHead,
      color: (t) => V(1.15 + t * 0.3),
    });
  }
  // Jaw with fangs.
  loftZ(
    B,
    [
      { z: hz - 0.03, hw: 0.075, top: 0.02, bot: 0.045, cy: -0.02 },
      { z: hz + 0.06, hw: 0.07, top: 0.02, bot: 0.04, cy: -0.025 },
      { z: hz + 0.12, hw: 0.04, top: 0.015, bot: 0.03, cy: -0.03 },
    ],
    { sides: 8, exp: 0.6, slot: SLOT.skin, weights: wJaw, color: () => V(0.78) }
  );
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    spike(B, {
      base: P(0.05 * s, -0.005, hz + 0.09),
      tip: P(0.055 * s, -0.09, hz + 0.11),
      radius: 0.022,
      sides: 4,
      slot: SLOT.none,
      weights: wHead,
      color: () => FANG,
    });
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- legs ----
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    const sfx = s > 0 ? 'L' : 'R';
    const wLeg = rig.grouped([`leg${sfx}`, `foot${sfx}`, 'root'], 2.6, 2);
    tube(B, {
      path: [rig.p(`leg${sfx}`).add(P(0, 0.06, 0)), rig.p(`leg${sfx}`), rig.p(`foot${sfx}`)],
      rings: 5,
      sides: 5,
      profile: (t) => 0.038 - t * 0.014,
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wLeg,
      color: () => V(0.8),
      capStart: false,
    });
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      spike(B, {
        base: rig.p(`foot${sfx}`),
        tip: rig.p(`foot${sfx}`).add(P(i * 0.05, -0.07, 0.06 - Math.abs(i) * 0.04)),
        radius: 0.018,
        sides: 4,
        slot: SLOT.none,
        weights: rig.fixed(`foot${sfx}`),
        color: () => FANG,
      });
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------- wings ----
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    const sfx = s > 0 ? 'L' : 'R';
    const w1 = rig.p(`wing${sfx}1`);
    const w2 = rig.p(`wing${sfx}2`);
    const w3 = rig.p(`wing${sfx}3`);
    const wWing = rig.grouped([`wing${sfx}1`, `wing${sfx}2`, `wing${sfx}3`, 'root'], 2.2, 2);

    // Leading-edge spar plus two finger spars fanning to the trailing edge.
    tube(B, {
      path: [w1, w2, w3],
      rings: 7,
      sides: 5,
      profile: (t) => 0.05 - t * 0.03,
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wWing,
      color: (t) => V(0.72 + t * 0.2),
      capStart: true,
      capEnd: true,
    });

    // Membrane: a 4x4 sheet from the shoulder to the tips, scalloped at the back.
    const spanPts = [
      P(0.02 * s, 0.06, -0.06),
      w1.clone(),
      w2.clone(),
      w3.clone(),
      w3.clone().add(P(0.14 * s, -0.03, -0.05)),
    ];
    const trail = [
      P(0.05 * s, -0.04, -0.3),
      w1.clone().add(P(0.02 * s, -0.06, -0.46)),
      w2.clone().add(P(0.0, -0.05, -0.52)),
      w3.clone().add(P(-0.02 * s, -0.02, -0.34)),
      w3.clone().add(P(0.12 * s, -0.03, -0.12)),
    ];
    const grid = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < spanPts.length; r++) {
      const row = [];
      for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
        const t = c / 3;
        const p = spanPts[r].clone().lerp(trail[r], t);
        // Sag the membrane between the spars so it never looks like paper.
        p.y -= Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.035 * (0.4 + r * 0.2);
        row.push(p);
      }
      grid.push(row);
    }
    emitGrid(B, grid, {
      wrap: false,
      slot: SLOT.cloth,
      weights: wWing,
      color: (rt, ct) => V(0.62 + rt * 0.4 + ct * 0.34),
      flip: s < 0,
    });

    // Claw hook at the wing elbow — the classic bat read.
    spike(B, {
      base: w2.clone(),
      tip: w2.clone().add(P(0.06 * s, 0.14, 0.05)),
      radius: 0.028,
      sides: 4,
      slot: SLOT.none,
      weights: rig.fixed(`wing${sfx}2`),
      color: () => FANG,
    });
  }

  return { rig, geometry: B.toGeometry(), clips: clips(rig), meta: META };
}

/**
 * Flyer — the thing that owns the sky above the island.
 *
 * Silhouette brief: read entirely against the sky, from below, in motion. So it
 * is almost all wing: a 2.4 m membrane span on a small pinched body, with a long
 * segmented tail and a lit stinger trailing behind. The body is deliberately
 * tiny so that the wing shape — and the moment it folds them for a dive — is the
 * only thing the player has to track.
 *
 * Its root bone is the body centre, not the feet: the AI drives altitude.
 */
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { Rig, SkinBuilder, SLOT, g, emitGrid, loftZ, tube, blob, plate, spike } from './Rig.js';

const V = (v) => g(v * 0.5);
const P = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
const DARKC = new THREE.Color(0.03, 0.025, 0.035);
const FANG = new THREE.Color(0.6, 0.58, 0.55);

const SPEC = [
  ['root', null, [0, 0, 0]],
  ['neck', 'root', [0, 0.05, 0.18]],
  ['head', 'neck', [0, 0.0, 0.14]],
  ['jaw', 'head', [0, -0.05, 0.04]],
  ['abdA', 'root', [0, -0.03, -0.22]],
  ['abdB', 'abdA', [0, -0.03, -0.2]],
  ['sting', 'abdB', [0, -0.03, -0.17]],
  ['wingL1', 'root', [0.13, 0.12, 0.02]],
  ['wingL2', 'wingL1', [0.44, 0.09, -0.05]],
  ['wingL3', 'wingL2', [0.42, -0.01, -0.09]],
  ['wingR1', 'root', [-0.13, 0.12, 0.02]],
  ['wingR2', 'wingR1', [-0.44, 0.09, -0.05]],
  ['wingR3', 'wingR2', [-0.42, -0.01, -0.09]],
  ['legL', 'root', [0.1, -0.13, 0.05]],
  ['footL', 'legL', [0.03, -0.16, 0.03]],
  ['legR', 'root', [-0.1, -0.13, 0.05]],
  ['footR', 'legR', [-0.03, -0.16, 0.03]],
];

export function buildFlyer() {
  const rig = new Rig(SPEC);
  const B = new SkinBuilder();

  const wBody = rig.grouped(['root', 'neck', 'abdA'], 2.4, 2);
  const wHead = rig.fixed('head');
  const wJaw = rig.fixed('jaw');
  const wTail = rig.grouped(['abdA', 'abdB', 'sting'], 2.6, 2);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------- thorax ----
  loftZ(
    B,
    [
      { z: -0.24, hw: 0.06, top: 0.05, bot: 0.05 },
      { z: -0.14, hw: 0.13, top: 0.12, bot: 0.11 },
      { z: -0.02, hw: 0.17, top: 0.16, bot: 0.14 },
      { z: 0.1, hw: 0.15, top: 0.14, bot: 0.12 },
      { z: 0.2, hw: 0.1, top: 0.09, bot: 0.08 },
    ],

/**
 * Shared skinning toolkit for the enemy cast.
 *
 * Same strategy as the dragon: author a bone tree, read the bind-pose world
 * positions, build geometry in that space, weight each vertex to the nearest
 * bones inside an allowed group. Two things differ, both for cost reasons:
 *
 *  1. Geometry and AnimationClips are built ONCE per archetype and shared by
 *     every instance. Only the Skeleton and the material are per-instance, so
 *     forty enemies cost forty draw calls and one geometry upload each.
 *  2. Vertex colours do not carry the palette. They carry *value* — the shading
 *     detail — plus a `slot` id saying which palette entry the hue comes from.
 *     The biome tint is then a handful of uniforms, so the same buffer serves a
 *     frostspire gnorc and a cinderpeak one.
 *
 * Slots: 0 literal · 1 skin · 2 cloth · 3 metal · 4 glowA · 5 glowB.
 * Slots 4/5 also feed emissive, which is how eyes, gems, forge vents and turret
 * cores light up without a single extra draw call.
 */
import * as THREE from 'three';

export const DEG = Math.PI / 180;

export const SLOT = { none: 0, skin: 1, cloth: 2, metal: 3, glowA: 4, glowB: 5 };

const _v0 = new THREE.Vector3();
const _v1 = new THREE.Vector3();
const _v2 = new THREE.Vector3();
const _n = new THREE.Vector3();
const UP = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

/** Grey helper — authored value for anything that takes a palette slot. */
export function g(v) {
  return new THREE.Color(v, v, v);
}

/** HSL-space nudge, used to derive enemy hues from a biome palette. */
export function shade(hex, dL = 0, dS = 0, dH = 0) {
  const c = new THREE.Color(hex);
  const hsl = { h: 0, s: 0, l: 0 };
  c.getHSL(hsl);
  c.setHSL(
    (hsl.h + dH + 1) % 1,
    THREE.MathUtils.clamp(hsl.s + dS, 0, 1),
    THREE.MathUtils.clamp(hsl.l + dL, 0.02, 0.98)
  );
  return c;
}

export function luminance(hex) {
  const c = new THREE.Color(hex);
  return 0.2126 * c.r + 0.7152 * c.g + 0.0722 * c.b;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export class SkinBuilder {
  constructor() {
    this.pos = [];
    this.nor = [];
    this.col = [];
    this.slot = [];
    this.si = [];
    this.sw = [];
    this.idx = [];
  }

  get count() {
    return this.pos.length / 3;
  }

  vert(p, n, color, weights, slot = 0) {
    this.pos.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
    this.nor.push(n.x, n.y, n.z);
    this.col.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
    this.slot.push(slot);
    const w = weights.slice(0, 4);
    while (w.length < 4) w.push([0, 0]);
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) sum += w[i][1];
    if (sum <= 0) sum = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      this.si.push(w[i][0]);
      this.sw.push(w[i][1] / sum);
    }
    return this.count - 1;
  }

  tri(a, b, c) {
    this.idx.push(a, b, c);
  }

  quad(a, b, c, d) {
    this.idx.push(a, b, c, a, c, d);
  }

  /** Hard-edged triangle: fresh verts, one face normal. */
  triFlat(p0, p1, p2, color, weights, slot = 0, flip = false) {
    _v0.subVectors(p1, p0);
    _v1.subVectors(p2, p0);
    _n.crossVectors(_v0, _v1).normalize();
    if (flip) _n.negate();
    const a = this.vert(p0, _n, color, weights, slot);
    const b = this.vert(p1, _n, color, weights, slot);
    const c = this.vert(p2, _n, color, weights, slot);
    if (flip) this.tri(a, c, b);
    else this.tri(a, b, c);
  }

  /** Hard-edged quad, wound p0→p1→p2→p3. */
  quadFlat(p0, p1, p2, p3, color, weights, slot = 0) {
    _v0.subVectors(p1, p0);
    _v1.subVectors(p3, p0);
    _n.crossVectors(_v0, _v1).normalize();
    const a = this.vert(p0, _n, color, weights, slot);
    const b = this.vert(p1, _n, color, weights, slot);
    const c = this.vert(p2, _n, color, weights, slot);
    const d = this.vert(p3, _n, color, weights, slot);
    this.quad(a, b, c, d);
  }

  toGeometry() {
    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(this.pos, 3));
    geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(this.nor, 3));
    geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(this.col, 3));
    geo.setAttribute('aSlot', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(this.slot, 1));
    geo.setAttribute('skinIndex', new THREE.Uint16BufferAttribute(this.si, 4));
    geo.setAttribute('skinWeight', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(this.sw, 4));
    geo.setIndex(this.idx);
    geo.computeBoundingSphere();
    return geo;
  }
}

/**
 * A bone tree plus everything needed to author geometry in its bind pose.
 * The Rig itself is a template: `instantiate()` hands out fresh bones so every
 * enemy animates independently while sharing one geometry.
 */
export class Rig {
  constructor(spec) {
    this.spec = spec;
    this.boneIndex = {};
    this.rest = {};
    this.names = [];

    const map = {};
    const bones = [];
    for (const [name, parent, off] of spec) {
      const b = new THREE.Bone();
      b.name = name;
      b.position.set(off[0], off[1], off[2]);
      map[name] = b;
      this.boneIndex[name] = bones.length;
      this.rest[name] = new THREE.Vector3(off[0], off[1], off[2]);
      this.names.push(name);
      bones.push(b);
      if (parent) map[parent].add(b);
    }
    bones[0].updateMatrixWorld(true);

    this.bindPos = {};
    for (const b of bones) this.bindPos[b.name] = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(b.matrixWorld);
  }

  instantiate() {
    const map = {};
    const bones = [];
    for (const [name, parent, off] of this.spec) {
      const b = new THREE.Bone();
      b.name = name;
      b.position.set(off[0], off[1], off[2]);
      map[name] = b;
      bones.push(b);
      if (parent) map[parent].add(b);
    }
    bones[0].updateMatrixWorld(true);
    return { root: bones[0], bones, map, skeleton: new THREE.Skeleton(bones) };
  }

    return this.bindPos[name].clone();
  }

    capEnd = false,

function resample(path, count) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(path, false, 'centripetal', 0.4);
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) out.push(curve.getPointAt(i / (count - 1)));
  return out;
}

/**
 * Deformable ellipsoid. `deform(p, dir, u, v)` may move the point freely;
 * normals are recovered from the resulting surface.
 */
export function blob(B, opts) {
  const {
    center,
    radius,
    segU = 12,
    segV = 8,
    color,
    slot = 0,
    weights,
    deform = null,
  } = opts;
  const r = Array.isArray(radius) ? radius : [radius, radius, radius];

  const grid = [];
  for (let v = 0; v <= segV; v++) {
    const phi = (v / segV) * Math.PI;
    const row = [];
    for (let u = 0; u < segU; u++) {
      const th = (u / segU) * Math.PI * 2;
      const dir = new THREE.Vector3(
        Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(th),
        Math.cos(phi),
        Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(th)
      );
      const p = new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dir.x * r[0], center.y + dir.y * r[1], center.z + dir.z * r[2]);
      if (deform) deform(p, dir, u / segU, v / segV);
      row.push(p);
    }
    grid.push(row);
  }
  return emitGrid(B, grid, { color, slot, weights, wrap: true });
}

/**
 * Superellipse ring — the workhorse cross-section. `exp` near 1 is an ellipse,
 * near 0.5 a rounded box. Chunky characters want rounded boxes.
 */
function superRing(sides, ru, rv, exp, out) {
  for (let s = 0; s < sides; s++) {
    const a = (s / sides) * Math.PI * 2;
    const cu = Math.cos(a);
    const cv = Math.sin(a);
    out[s * 2] = Math.sign(cu) * Math.pow(Math.abs(cu), exp) * ru;
    out[s * 2 + 1] = Math.sign(cv) * Math.pow(Math.abs(cv), exp) * rv;
  }
  return out;
}

/** Rings stacked along Y: torsos, limbs, stalks. */
export function loftY(B, rings, opts = {}) {
  const { sides = 12, exp = 0.7, origin = null, color, slot = 0, weights, capStart = true, capEnd = true } = opts;
  const buf = new Array(sides * 2);
  const grid = [];
  for (const r of rings) {
    superRing(sides, r.rx, r.rz ?? r.rx, r.exp ?? exp, buf);
    const row = [];
    for (let s = 0; s < sides; s++) {
      const p = new THREE.Vector3(buf[s * 2] + (r.cx ?? 0), r.y, buf[s * 2 + 1] + (r.cz ?? 0));
      if (origin) p.add(origin);
      row.push(p);
    }
    grid.push(row);
  }
  return emitGrid(B, grid, { color, slot, weights, wrap: true, capStart, capEnd });
}

/** Rings stacked along Z: heads, snouts, muzzles. */
export function loftZ(B, rings, opts = {}) {
  const { sides = 12, exp = 0.68, origin = null, color, slot = 0, weights, capStart = true, capEnd = true } = opts;
  const buf = new Array(sides * 2);
  const grid = [];
  for (const r of rings) {
    const top = r.top ?? r.ry ?? r.hw;
    const bot = r.bot ?? -(r.ry ?? r.hw);
    superRing(sides, r.hw, 1, r.exp ?? exp, buf);
    const row = [];
    for (let s = 0; s < sides; s++) {
      const v = buf[s * 2 + 1];
      const y = (v >= 0 ? top : -bot) * v + (r.cy ?? 0);
      const p = new THREE.Vector3(buf[s * 2] + (r.cx ?? 0), y, r.z);
      if (origin) p.add(origin);
      row.push(p);
    }
    grid.push(row);
  }
  return emitGrid(B, grid, { color, slot, weights, wrap: true, capStart, capEnd });
}

/** Hard-edged box, optionally rotated. Used for armour, helmets, crates. */
export function boxFlat(B, opts) {
  const { center, size, rot = null, color, slot = 0, weights, taper = 1, shear = 0 } = opts;
  const h = [size[0] / 2, size[1] / 2, size[2] / 2];
  const q = rot ? (rot.isQuaternion ? rot : new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(rot)) : null;
  const corners = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const sx = i & 1 ? 1 : -1;
    const sy = i & 2 ? 1 : -1;
    const sz = i & 4 ? 1 : -1;
    const k = sy > 0 ? taper : 1;
    const p = new THREE.Vector3(sx * h[0] * k, sy * h[1], sz * h[2] * k);
    p.z += sy * shear;
    if (q) p.applyQuaternion(q);
    p.add(center);
    corners.push(p);
  }
  const C = (i) => corners[i];
  const w = typeof weights === 'function' ? weights(center) : weights;
  const col = typeof color === 'function' ? color(center) : color;
  // -Y, +Y, -Z, +Z, -X, +X
  B.quadFlat(C(0), C(4), C(5), C(1), col, w, slot);
  B.quadFlat(C(2), C(3), C(7), C(6), col, w, slot);
  B.quadFlat(C(0), C(1), C(3), C(2), col, w, slot);
  B.quadFlat(C(4), C(6), C(7), C(5), col, w, slot);
  B.quadFlat(C(0), C(2), C(6), C(4), col, w, slot);
  B.quadFlat(C(1), C(5), C(7), C(3), col, w, slot);
  return corners;
}

 * A flat plate: four corners, both faces, with a slight thickness so it still
 * catches a rim light. Ears, wing membranes, capes, fins.

uniform vec3 uGlowA;

name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

# Allow the workflow to publish Pages using OIDC rather than a PAT.
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Never run two deploys at once, but let a newer push supersede a queued one.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:

          cache: npm

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages

 * Tests for Flyer.buildFlyer().
 *
 * The function is a pure procedural factory: it assembles a bone rig, a skinned

 * the archetype metadata.  The tests below observe that returned bundle only;
 * they never reach into the emitters directly.

import * as THREE from 'three';
import { buildFlyer, META } from '../../../../src/actors/enemies/Flyer.js';

const BONE_NAMES = [
  'root', 'neck', 'head', 'jaw',
  'abdA', 'abdB', 'sting',
  'wingL1', 'wingL2', 'wingL3',
  'wingR1', 'wingR2', 'wingR3',
  'legL', 'footL', 'legR', 'footR',
];

  neck: 'root',
  head: 'neck',
  jaw: 'head',
  abdA: 'root',
  abdB: 'abdA',
  sting: 'abdB',
  wingL1: 'root',
  wingL2: 'wingL1',
  wingL3: 'wingL2',
  wingR1: 'root',
  wingR2: 'wingR1',
  wingR3: 'wingR2',
  legL: 'root',
  footL: 'legL',
  legR: 'root',
  footR: 'legR',
};

const SLOT = { none: 0, skin: 1, cloth: 2, metal: 3, glowA: 4, glowB: 5 };

const DARK_COLOR = [0.03, 0.025, 0.035];
const FANG_COLOR = [0.6, 0.58, 0.55];

const attr = (geometry, name) => geometry.getAttribute(name);

function vertexColor(geometry, i) {
  const c = attr(geometry, 'color');
  return [c.getX(i), c.getY(i), c.getZ(i)];
}

function vertexPosition(geometry, i) {
  const p = attr(geometry, 'position');
  return [p.getX(i), p.getY(i), p.getZ(i)];
}

function dominantBone(bundle, i) {
  const si = attr(bundle.geometry, 'skinIndex');
  const sw = attr(bundle.geometry, 'skinWeight');
  let best = -1;
  let bone = -1;
  for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
    const w = sw.array[i * 4 + k];
    if (w > best) {
      best = w;
      bone = si.array[i * 4 + k];
    }
  }
  return { name: bundle.rig.names[bone], index: bone, weight: best };
}

function colorMatches(geometry, i, rgb, eps = 1e-5) {
  const c = vertexColor(geometry, i);
  return c.every((v, k) => Math.abs(v - rgb[k]) <= eps);
}

function trackNamed(clip, name) {
  return clip.tracks.find((track) => track.name === name);
}

describe('buildFlyer() clips', () => {
  test('provides the full flyer animation set with aliases and durations', () => {
    const { clips } = build();

    expect(Object.keys(clips)).toEqual([
      'idle', 'walk', 'hover', 'run', 'alert', 'dive', 'attack', 'hurt', 'die', 'taunt',
    ]);
    expect(clips.idle.duration).toBeCloseTo(1.05, 6);
    expect(clips.walk.duration).toBeCloseTo(0.72, 6);
    expect(clips.hover.duration).toBeCloseTo(0.4, 6);
    expect(clips.alert.duration).toBeCloseTo(0.7, 6);
    expect(clips.dive.duration).toBeCloseTo(0.5, 6);
    expect(clips.attack.duration).toBeCloseTo(0.55, 6);
    expect(clips.hurt.duration).toBeCloseTo(0.34, 6);
    expect(clips.die.duration).toBeCloseTo(1.0, 6);

    // Aliases are intentional shared clip instances.
    expect(clips.run).toBe(clips.walk);
    expect(clips.taunt).toBe(clips.alert);
    expect(clips.run.name).toBe('walk');
    expect(clips.taunt.name).toBe('alert');
  });

  test('marks looping wingbeats and one-shot reaction clips', () => {
    const { clips } = build();

    for (const key of ['idle', 'walk', 'hover', 'dive']) {
      expect(clips[key].userData.loop).toBe(THREE.LoopRepeat);
    }
    for (const key of ['alert', 'attack', 'hurt', 'die']) {
      expect(clips[key].userData.loop).toBe(THREE.LoopOnce);
    }
  });

  test('all tracks target real bones, are finite, and keep ordered keyframes', () => {
    const { clips, rig } = build();
    const bones = new Set(rig.names);

    for (const [clipName, clip] of Object.entries(clips)) {
      expect(clip).toBeInstanceOf(THREE.AnimationClip);
      expect(clip.name).toBe(clipName === 'run' ? 'walk' : clipName === 'taunt' ? 'alert' : clipName);
      expect(Number.isFinite(clip.duration)).toBe(true);
      expect(clip.duration).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(clip.tracks.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

      const seen = new Set();
      for (const track of clip.tracks) {
        expect(track).toBeInstanceOf(THREE.KeyframeTrack);
        const match = /^([A-Za-z0-9]+)\.(quaternion|position)$/.exec(track.name);
        expect(match).not.toBe(null);
        expect(bones.has(match[1])).toBe(true);
        expect(seen.has(track.name)).toBe(false);
        seen.add(track.name);

        const stride = match[2] === 'quaternion' ? 4 : 3;
        expect(track.values.length).toBe(track.times.length * stride);
        expect(track.times.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
        expect(track.times[0]).toBeCloseTo(0, 6);
        expect(track.times[track.times.length - 1]).toBeCloseTo(clip.duration, 5);

        for (let i = 0; i < track.times.length; i++) {
          expect(Number.isFinite(track.times[i])).toBe(true);
          if (i > 0) expect(track.times[i]).toBeGreaterThan(track.times[i - 1]);
        }
        for (const value of track.values) expect(Number.isFinite(value)).toBe(true);

        if (stride === 4) {
          for (let i = 0; i < track.values.length; i += 4) {
            const length = Math.hypot(
              track.values[i], track.values[i + 1], track.values[i + 2], track.values[i + 3]
            );
            expect(length).toBeCloseTo(1, 5);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  test('flap clips contain seven evenly spaced keys and a vertical body bob', () => {
    const { clips } = build();
    const bobs = { idle: 0.05, walk: 0.045, hover: 0.02 };

    for (const [name, bob] of Object.entries(bobs)) {
      const clip = clips[name];
      expect(clip.tracks).toHaveLength(17);
      for (const track of clip.tracks) expect(track.times).toHaveLength(7);

      const rootPos = trackNamed(clip, 'root.position');
      expect(rootPos).toBeDefined();
      expect(rootPos.times).toHaveLength(7);
      for (let i = 0; i < rootPos.times.length; i++) {
        expect(rootPos.times[i]).toBeCloseTo((i / 6) * clip.duration, 5);
      }

      let maxBob = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < rootPos.values.length; i += 3) {
        expect(rootPos.values[i]).toBeCloseTo(0, 6);      // no lateral drift
        expect(rootPos.values[i + 2]).toBeCloseTo(0, 6);  // no forward drift
        maxBob = Math.max(maxBob, Math.abs(rootPos.values[i + 1]));
      }
      expect(maxBob).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(maxBob).toBeLessThanOrEqual(bob + 1e-6);
      // Six samples per cycle land on sin(±60°), giving a visible ripple.
      expect(maxBob).toBeCloseTo(bob * Math.sin(Math.PI / 3), 5);

      // The wings really move through the cycle.
      const wing = trackNamed(clip, 'wingL1.quaternion');
      const distinct = new Set();
      for (let i = 0; i < wing.values.length; i += 4) {
        distinct.add(Array.from(wing.values.slice(i, i + 4)).join(','));
      }
      expect(distinct.size).toBeGreaterThan(2);
    }
  });

  test('reaction clips author three or four poses and animate jaw and body', () => {
    const { clips } = build();

    // Alert and attack hold four poses; dive, hurt and die are short three-pose clips.
    for (const name of ['alert', 'attack']) {
      for (const track of clips[name].tracks) expect(track.times).toHaveLength(4);
    }
    for (const name of ['dive', 'hurt', 'die']) {
      for (const track of clips[name].tracks) expect(track.times).toHaveLength(3);
    }

    for (const name of ['alert', 'attack', 'hurt', 'die']) {
      expect(trackNamed(clips[name], 'jaw.quaternion')).toBeDefined();
    }
    expect(trackNamed(clips.dive, 'jaw.quaternion')).toBeDefined();
    expect(trackNamed(clips.dive, 'root.position')).toBeUndefined();

    // The attack snaps the jaws open and drives the body downward on the pass.
    const attackJaw = trackNamed(clips.attack, 'jaw.quaternion');
    const attackRoot = trackNamed(clips.attack, 'root.position');
    const jawAngle = 2 * Math.acos(Math.min(1, Math.abs(attackJaw.values[7])));
    expect(jawAngle).toBeGreaterThan(0.75);
    expect(attackRoot.values[4]).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(attackRoot.values[7]).toBeLessThan(0);

    // The die animation lifts, then drops the root as the body tumbles.
    const dieRoot = trackNamed(clips.die, 'root.position');
    expect(dieRoot.values[4]).toBeGreaterThan(0);

function buildGnorc() {
  const rig = new Rig(SPEC);
  const B = new SkinBuilder();

  const wTorso = rig.grouped(['hips', 'belly', 'chest', 'neck'], 2.4, 2);
  const wHead = rig.fixed('head');
  const wJaw = rig.fixed('jaw');
  const wHips = rig.fixed('hips');
  const wClub = rig.fixed('club');

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- body ----
  loftY(
    B,
    [
      { y: 0.33, rx: 0.19, rz: 0.16, cz: 0.0, exp: 0.6 },
      { y: 0.44, rx: 0.27, rz: 0.23, cz: 0.01 },
      { y: 0.56, rx: 0.325, rz: 0.28, cz: 0.03 },
      { y: 0.67, rx: 0.335, rz: 0.29, cz: 0.045 },
      { y: 0.78, rx: 0.305, rz: 0.25, cz: 0.025 },
      { y: 0.88, rx: 0.295, rz: 0.225, cz: 0.0 },
      { y: 0.97, rx: 0.26, rz: 0.195, cz: -0.01 },
      { y: 1.035, rx: 0.135, rz: 0.125, cz: 0.005 },
    ],
    {
      sides: 14,
      exp: 0.66,
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wTorso,
      color: (t, c, p) => V(0.78 + t * 0.34 + (p.z > 0 ? 0.08 : 0)),
    }
  );

  // Belly plate — a lighter underside, the classic cartoon read.
  loftY(
    B,
    [
      { y: 0.42, rx: 0.16, rz: 0.06, cz: 0.2 },
      { y: 0.56, rx: 0.2, rz: 0.07, cz: 0.245 },
      { y: 0.68, rx: 0.2, rz: 0.07, cz: 0.255 },
      { y: 0.79, rx: 0.155, rz: 0.06, cz: 0.225 },
    ],
    { sides: 10, exp: 0.8, slot: SLOT.skin, weights: wTorso, color: () => V(1.32), capStart: false, capEnd: false }
  );

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- belt ----
  loftY(
    B,
    [
      { y: 0.685, rx: 0.335, rz: 0.29, cz: 0.045 },
      { y: 0.735, rx: 0.35, rz: 0.305, cz: 0.045 },
      { y: 0.775, rx: 0.325, rz: 0.275, cz: 0.04 },
    ],
    { sides: 14, exp: 0.66, slot: SLOT.cloth, weights: wTorso, color: () => V(1.0), capStart: false, capEnd: false }
  );
  boxFlat(B, {
    center: P(0, 0.735, 0.335),
    size: [0.15, 0.13, 0.07],
    slot: SLOT.metal,
    weights: wTorso,
    color: V(1.15),
  });

  // Loincloth, front and back.
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    plate(B, {
      corners: [
        P(-0.13, 0.72, 0.3 * s),
        P(0.13, 0.72, 0.3 * s),
        P(0.11, 0.38, 0.26 * s),
        P(-0.11, 0.38, 0.26 * s),
      ],
      thickness: 0.02,
      slot: SLOT.cloth,
      weights: wHips,
      color: V(0.85),
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- legs ----
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    const sfx = s > 0 ? 'L' : 'R';
    const wLeg = rig.grouped([`thigh${sfx}`, `shin${sfx}`, `foot${sfx}`, 'hips'], 2.6, 2);
    tube(B, {
      path: [
        rig.p(`thigh${sfx}`).setY(0.47),
        rig.p(`shin${sfx}`),
        rig.p(`foot${sfx}`).add(P(0, 0.02, -0.01)),
      ],
      rings: 6,
      sides: 8,
      profile: (t) => [0.145 - t * 0.045, 0.135 - t * 0.04],
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wLeg,
      color: (t) => V(0.82 + t * 0.12),
      capStart: true,
      capEnd: true,
    });
    // Big flat feet with three blunt claws.
    const wFoot = rig.fixed(`foot${sfx}`);
    boxFlat(B, {
      center: P(0.185 * s, 0.05, 0.085),
      size: [0.235, 0.1, 0.36],
      taper: 0.86,
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wFoot,
      color: V(0.7),
    });
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      spike(B, {
        base: P(0.185 * s + i * 0.075, 0.045, 0.24),
        tip: P(0.185 * s + i * 0.085, 0.035, 0.33),
        radius: 0.032,
        sides: 5,
        slot: SLOT.none,
        weights: wFoot,
        color: () => IVORY,
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- arms ----
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    const sfx = s > 0 ? 'L' : 'R';
    const wArm = rig.grouped([`arm${sfx}`, `fore${sfx}`, `hand${sfx}`, 'chest'], 2.6, 2);
    blob(B, {
      center: rig.p(`arm${sfx}`).add(P(0.02 * s, 0.03, 0)),
      radius: [0.125, 0.115, 0.115],
      segU: 8,
      segV: 6,
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wArm,
      color: () => V(0.98),
    });
    tube(B, {
      path: [rig.p(`arm${sfx}`), rig.p(`fore${sfx}`), rig.p(`hand${sfx}`)],
      rings: 6,
      sides: 7,
      profile: (t) => 0.088 - t * 0.02,
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wArm,
      color: (t) => V(0.88 + t * 0.1),
      capStart: true,
    });
    blob(B, {
      center: rig.p(`hand${sfx}`).add(P(0.02 * s, -0.03, 0.01)),
      radius: [0.105, 0.1, 0.11],
      segU: 8,
      segV: 6,
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: rig.fixed(`hand${sfx}`),
      color: () => V(1.05),
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- head ----
  const hy = 1.15;
  loftZ(
    B,
    [
      { z: -0.15, hw: 0.09, top: 0.08, bot: 0.08, cy: hy - 0.01 },
      { z: -0.08, hw: 0.175, top: 0.145, bot: 0.125, cy: hy },
      { z: 0.01, hw: 0.2, top: 0.155, bot: 0.135, cy: hy },
      { z: 0.1, hw: 0.18, top: 0.12, bot: 0.13, cy: hy - 0.012 },
      { z: 0.18, hw: 0.125, top: 0.075, bot: 0.11, cy: hy - 0.03 },
      { z: 0.235, hw: 0.075, top: 0.045, bot: 0.075, cy: hy - 0.045 },
    ],
    {
      sides: 12,
      exp: 0.62,
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wHead,
      color: (t, c, p) => V(0.9 + (p.y - hy) * 0.9),
    }
  );

  // Brow ridge — the whole scowl lives here.
  boxFlat(B, {
    center: P(0, hy + 0.075, 0.115),
    size: [0.33, 0.075, 0.13],
    rot: new THREE.Euler(-0.34, 0, 0),
    taper: 0.85,
    slot: SLOT.skin,
    weights: wHead,
    color: V(0.62),
  });

  // Eyes: a dark socket with a hot pinprick inside.
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    blob(B, {
      center: P(0.078 * s, hy + 0.015, 0.155),
      radius: [0.05, 0.045, 0.035],
      segU: 7,
      segV: 5,
      slot: SLOT.none,
      weights: wHead,
      color: () => SOCKET,
    });
    blob(B, {
      center: P(0.082 * s, hy + 0.018, 0.182),
      radius: [0.028, 0.03, 0.02],
      segU: 6,
      segV: 4,
      slot: SLOT.glowA,
      weights: wHead,
      color: () => V(1.3),
    });
  }

  // Snout ridge + nostrils.
  boxFlat(B, {
    center: P(0, hy - 0.045, 0.215),
    size: [0.11, 0.07, 0.09],
    slot: SLOT.skin,
    weights: wHead,
    color: V(1.12),
  });

  // Ears — wide flappy triangles swept back.
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    plate(B, {
      corners: [
        P(0.17 * s, hy + 0.04, 0.0),
        P(0.34 * s, hy + 0.12, -0.09),
        P(0.36 * s, hy - 0.02, -0.14),
        P(0.18 * s, hy - 0.06, -0.02),
      ],
      thickness: 0.022,
      slot: SLOT.skin,
      weights: wHead,
      color: V(1.18),
    });
  }

  // Cranial horn — a single back-swept nub that breaks the round skull.
  spike(B, {
    base: P(0, hy + 0.11, -0.05),
    tip: P(0, hy + 0.28, -0.16),
    radius: 0.055,
    sides: 6,
    slot: SLOT.metal,
    weights: wHead,
    color: (t) => V(0.9 + t * 0.4),
  });

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------- jaw ----
  const jy = 1.07;
  loftZ(
    B,
    [
      { z: -0.02, hw: 0.15, top: 0.05, bot: 0.055, cy: jy },
      { z: 0.1, hw: 0.165, top: 0.05, bot: 0.06, cy: jy - 0.005 },
      { z: 0.2, hw: 0.15, top: 0.045, bot: 0.05, cy: jy - 0.015 },
      { z: 0.265, hw: 0.09, top: 0.035, bot: 0.035, cy: jy - 0.025 },
    ],
    { sides: 10, exp: 0.55, slot: SLOT.skin, weights: wJaw, color: (t) => V(1.05 + t * 0.1) }
  );
  // Tusks curling up out of the underbite.
  for (const s of [1, -1]) {
    spike(B, {
      base: P(0.115 * s, jy + 0.02, 0.185),
      tip: P(0.135 * s, jy + 0.2, 0.155),
      radius: 0.038,
      sides: 5,
      bend: P(0.02 * s, 0, -0.04),
      slot: SLOT.none,
      weights: wJaw,
      color: () => IVORY,
    });
  }
  // Little bottom teeth.
  for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
    if (i === 0) continue;
    spike(B, {
      base: P(i * 0.05, jy + 0.03, 0.235),
      tip: P(i * 0.05, jy + 0.09, 0.225),
      radius: 0.02,
      sides: 4,
      slot: SLOT.none,
      weights: wJaw,
      color: () => IVORY,
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- club ----
  const cb = rig.p('club');
  tube(B, {
    path: [
      cb.clone().add(P(0, -0.12, -0.04)),
      cb.clone().add(P(0, 0.08, 0.02)),
      cb.clone().add(P(0, 0.3, 0.08)),
      cb.clone().add(P(0, 0.44, 0.12)),
    ],
    rings: 7,
    sides: 7,
    profile: (t) => 0.036 + Math.pow(t, 2.4) * 0.085,
    slot: SLOT.cloth,
    weights: wClub,
    color: (t) => V(0.72 + t * 0.2),
    capStart: true,
    capEnd: true,
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const a = (i / 4) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.4;
    boxFlat(B, {
      center: cb.clone().add(P(Math.cos(a) * 0.095, 0.34, 0.09 + Math.sin(a) * 0.09)),
      size: [0.06, 0.06, 0.06],
      rot: new THREE.Euler(0.3, a, 0.2),
      slot: SLOT.metal,
      weights: wClub,
      color: V(1.2),
    });
  }

  return { rig, geometry: B.toGeometry(), clips: clips(rig), meta: META };
}

/**
 * Gnorc — the stumpy comic grunt.
 *
 * Silhouette brief: everything below the belt is heavy and everything above it
 * is small and mean. Pot belly, tiny sunken head, jutting underbite with tusks,
 * skinny arms, comically oversized feet, and a club it holds like a lollipop.
 * At fifty metres you should read "short, wide, bottom-heavy, carrying a stick".
 */
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { Rig, SkinBuilder, SLOT, g, loftY, loftZ, tube, blob, boxFlat, plate, spike } from './Rig.js';

const V = (v) => g(v * 0.5);
const P = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
const IVORY = new THREE.Color(0.58, 0.55, 0.44);
const SOCKET = new THREE.Color(0.035, 0.03, 0.035);

// Faces +Z. Root sits between the feet, on the ground.
const SPEC = [
  ['root', null, [0, 0, 0]],
  ['hips', 'root', [0, 0.5, 0]],
  ['belly', 'hips', [0, 0.15, 0.03]],
  ['chest', 'belly', [0, 0.24, -0.03]],
  ['neck', 'chest', [0, 0.14, 0.02]],
  ['head', 'neck', [0, 0.1, 0.01]],
  ['jaw', 'head', [0, -0.08, 0.05]],
  ['armL', 'chest', [0.3, 0.05, 0]],
  ['foreL', 'armL', [0.17, -0.17, 0.02]],
  ['handL', 'foreL', [0.11, -0.15, 0.02]],
  ['armR', 'chest', [-0.3, 0.05, 0]],
  ['foreR', 'armR', [-0.17, -0.17, 0.02]],
  ['handR', 'foreR', [-0.11, -0.15, 0.02]],
  ['thighL', 'hips', [0.17, -0.07, 0]],
  ['shinL', 'thighL', [0.01, -0.21, 0]],
  ['footL', 'shinL', [0, -0.18, 0.03]],
  ['thighR', 'hips', [-0.17, -0.07, 0]],
  ['shinR', 'thighR', [-0.01, -0.21, 0]],
  ['footR', 'shinR', [0, -0.18, 0.03]],
  ['club', 'handR', [-0.03, 0.0, 0.06]],
];

export function buildGnorc() {
  const rig = new Rig(SPEC);
  const B = new SkinBuilder();

  const wTorso = rig.grouped(['hips', 'belly', 'chest', 'neck'], 2.4, 2);
  const wHead = rig.fixed('head');
  const wJaw = rig.fixed('jaw');
  const wHips = rig.fixed('hips');
  const wClub = rig.fixed('club');

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- body ----
  loftY(

 * so a brute never reads as a gnorc at fifty metres.

      bones.push(b);

    bones[0].updateMatrixWorld(true);

    for (const b of bones) this.bindPos[b.name] = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(b.matrixWorld);
  }

  /** Fresh bones + skeleton for one instance. Bind space is identity. */
  instantiate() {
    const map = {};
    const bones = [];
    for (const [name, parent, off] of this.spec) {
      const b = new THREE.Bone();
      b.name = name;
      b.position.set(off[0], off[1], off[2]);
      map[name] = b;
      bones.push(b);

function arrayOf(geometry, name) {
  return geometry.getAttribute(name).array;
}

function findTrack(clip, trackName) {
  const track = clip.tracks.find((t) => t.name === trackName);
  expect(track).toBeDefined();
  return track;
